source.label: Pre-calculus 12 · BC Ministry of Education · June 2018

bigIdeas.en: Using inverses is the foundation of solving equations and can be extended to relationships between functions.
bigIdeas.zh: 逆运算是解方程的根基，这一思想还可以推广到函数与函数之间的关系（反函数）。

bigIdeas.en: Understanding the characteristics of families of functions allows us to model and understand relationships and to build connections between classes of functions.
bigIdeas.zh: 理解各类函数族的特征，就能用它们建模、理解各种关系，并在不同类型的函数之间建立联系。

bigIdeas.en: Transformations of shapes extend to functions and relations in all of their representations.
bigIdeas.zh: 图形的变换可以推广到函数和关系上，不论用图象、方程还是表格来表示都适用。

elaborations.en: of graphs and equations of parent functions and relations (e.g., absolute value, radical, reciprocal, conics, exponential, logarithmic, trigonometric)
elaborations.zh: 对基本函数（parent function）和基本关系的图象与方程做变换（如绝对值、根式、倒数、圆锥曲线、指数、对数、三角函数）

elaborations.en: vertical and horizontal translations, stretches, and reflections
elaborations.zh: 竖直与水平方向的平移、伸缩和翻折

elaborations.en: inverses: graphs and equations
elaborations.zh: 反函数：图象与方程

elaborations.en: extension: recognizing composed functions (e.g., y =); operations on functions
elaborations.zh: 拓展：能看出一个函数是由哪些函数复合而成的；函数之间的加、减、乘、除运算

elaborations.en: graphing, including transformations
elaborations.zh: 画图象，包括图象的变换

elaborations.en: solving equations with same base and with different bases, including base e
elaborations.zh: 解同底和不同底的指数方程，包括以 e 为底

elaborations.en: solving problems in situational contexts
elaborations.zh: 解决实际情境中的问题

terms.zh: 指数增长 / 指数衰减

items.zh: 等比数列与等比级数（求和）

elaborations.en: common ratio, first term, general term
elaborations.zh: 公比、首项、通项

elaborations.en: geometric sequences connecting to exponential functions
elaborations.zh: 等比数列与指数函数的联系

elaborations.en: infinite geometric series
elaborations.zh: 无穷等比级数（无穷项求和）

elaborations.en: sigma notation
elaborations.zh: 求和符号 Σ（sigma 记号）

elaborations.en: applying laws of logarithms
elaborations.zh: 运用对数运算法则

elaborations.en: evaluating with different bases
elaborations.zh: 计算不同底的对数的值

elaborations.en: using common and natural logarithms
elaborations.zh: 使用常用对数（以 10 为底）和自然对数（以 e 为底）

elaborations.en: exploring inverse of exponential
elaborations.zh: 探究对数函数是指数函数的反函数

elaborations.en: graphing, including transformations
elaborations.zh: 画图象，包括图象的变换

elaborations.en: solving equations with same base and with different bases
elaborations.zh: 解同底和不同底的对数方程

elaborations.en: solving problems in situational contexts
elaborations.zh: 解决实际情境中的问题

terms.zh: 自然对数（以 e 为底）

items.zh: 多项式函数与多项式方程

elaborations.en: factoring, including the factor theorem and the remainder theorem
elaborations.zh: 因式分解，包括因式定理和余式定理

elaborations.en: graphing and the characteristics of a graph (e.g., degree, extrema, zeros, end-behaviour)
elaborations.zh: 画图象并分析图象特征（如次数、极值、零点、两端走向）

elaborations.en: solving equations algebraically and graphically
elaborations.zh: 用代数方法和图象法解方程

elaborations.en: characteristics of graphs, including asymptotes, intercepts, point discontinuities, domain, end-behaviour
elaborations.zh: 图象的特征，包括渐近线、截距、可去间断点（图象上的洞）、定义域、两端走向

terms.zh: 可去间断点（图象上的洞）

items.zh: 三角函数、三角方程与三角恒等式

elaborations.en: examining angles in standard position in both radians and degrees
elaborations.zh: 用角度制和弧度制研究标准位置角（顶点在原点、始边在 x 轴正半轴）

elaborations.en: exploring unit circle, reference and coterminal angles, special angles
elaborations.zh: 探究单位圆、参考角、终边相同的角，以及特殊角

elaborations.en: graphing primary trigonometric functions, including transformations and characteristics
elaborations.zh: 画基本三角函数（正弦、余弦、正切）的图象，包括图象的变换与特征

elaborations.en: solving first- and second-degree equations (over restricted domains and all real numbers)
elaborations.zh: 解一次和二次三角方程（在限定区间内和在全体实数范围内）

elaborations.en: solving problems in situational contexts
elaborations.zh: 解决实际情境中的问题

elaborations.en: using identities to reduce complexity in expressions and solve equations (e.g., Pythagorean, quotient, double angle, reciprocal, sum and difference)
elaborations.zh: 用恒等式化简式子、解方程（如平方关系、商数关系、二倍角、倒数关系、和差角公式）

terms.zh: 终边相同的角（同终边角）
